spans.s:
तुगा तुगा, f. the so-called Tabāṣīr (fr.
त्वक्-क्षीरा), a white secretion found sometimes in
the joints of bamboos, the manna of bamboos.
—तु-
गा-क्षीरी, f. a peculiar kind of bamboo manna; [cf.
तुका-क्षीरी.]

तुग्र तुग्र, अस्, m., N. of the father of
Bhujyu who was protected by the Aśvins; N. of an
enemy of Indra, conquered by the latter.

तुग्र्य, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic of Bhujyu; N.
of a man or of a race; (आ), f. water.
—तुग्र्या-
वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. delighting in the Tugryas; epi-
thet of Indra and of Soma; (Sāy.) increasing water,
increasing with water.
तुग्वन् तुग्वन्, अ, n., Ved. = तीर्थ, q. v.
